spans.s:
m. (-र्व्वः)
Submarine fire.
E.
उर्व्व a saint so named, from whose thighs sprang a being of flame, which was received by the ocean; the affix is अण्.

m. (-यः)
A name of the saint AGASTYA.
E.
उर्व्वशी the celestial courtezan, and ठक् affix; his birth being ascribed indirectly to this lady.

m. (-लः)
Submarine fire.
E.
और्व्व, and अनल fire.
